text:
Aisha: Quick status check ahead of Friday milestone — need one-line updates on packaging rate-limit work and contract constraints that affect metering/billing. Where are we on: a) quota mapping b) contract clamps for enterprise customers c) billing adapter changes? Ping owners please.

Marco: Product side — goal is to ship new rate-limit tiers + clear overage behavior. Blocker is contract language for overages and billing schema alignment.

Priya: Eng update — server-side quota enforcement implemented behind feature-flag, rolling to staging now. Need billing API v2 for stable metering IDs to complete integration. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/packaging/pulls/142

Sam: Billing — schema v2 is ready locally but DB migration needs review (foreign keys + backfill). If review passes, I can schedule migration in Thu 2am window.

Eve: Legal — reviewing overage clauses. Flagged two items: grace period ambiguity and hard cap wording. Can approve once we decide default behavior and add exception table for enterprise.

Jordan: Telemetry note — no model changes but we need a consistent tag `tier_id` on all requests for correct cost attribution. Will add to client-side SDK unless DevEx wants to handle.

Kai: DevEx — happy to add SDK helpers and a smoke test. Will update quickstarts and examples tomorrow.

Aisha: Owners roundup: Priya -> infra rollout; Sam -> DB migration + schema deploy; Eve -> contract sign-off; Jordan -> telemetry tags; Kai -> SDK/tests. If anyone misses ETA, call it out now.

Priya: One small snag — enforcement layer expects `meter_id`, Jordan's telemetry will emit `tier_id`. I'll add a mapping shim in the enforcement service. PR opened, needs Sam to confirm schema compatibility.

Sam: Looking at PR. If mapping is required I'll add backwards-compatible field `meter_alias` to schema and update backfill plan.

Priya: Great — I'll keep mapping behind the feature-flag and add unit coverage.

Marco: Also note: Dedicated customers with custom contract clauses may have different meter mappings. @Eve can you provide a token/clauses table so we can bake exceptions into the mapping?

Eve: Yes — will export exception table and share by EOD.

deploy-bot: Deployment started for feature-flag rollout to staging (staging-cluster-3). Build #4021.

Priya: Staging looks green overall, tests pass except one flaky in `quota_integration_test` — investigating root cause.

Kai: Flaky test is infra timing; I'll bump the test harness timeout and re-run.

Sam: DB migration queued for Thu 2am window (requested by Priya).

Aisha: One last ask — please add a one-line row to the rollout spreadsheet with: owner, ETA, current blocker. Link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/packaging-rollout :eyes:

Marco: :thumbsup:
